opening.argument: The presentation ties participation to an inviter, an ETH entry amount, team building, and the purchase or ownership of packages. Its description promotes “Only 0.03 ETH (Affordable) Earn Rapid Money with Rapido If youu build a team,” while the presenter says partners take places beneath a participant and that package ownership is required to earn commissions. The payment structure is expressly routed through wallets and an upline: “The first sale it will go to your wallet The second sale got your own wallet and the third sale will go the Spiria upline.” Sequential upgrades and filled positions further describe a recruitment-based matrix in which commissions depend on participation and placement. The earnings figures are acknowledged as projections, and the materials do not establish completed payments, realized returns, or external operation. Those limitations qualify the presentation but do not remove its financial solicitation and participation flow.
